name: Nornäs - Vassbotten
description: Nornäs to Vassbotten. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Älgafallet / Elgåfossen: Bohuslän's highest waterfall, also called Elgåfossen on the Norwegian side, with about 46 m total fall. Officially highlighted near the end of Stage 23; bridge below the falls crosses into Norway and information describes border history.
Bullarebygdens customer water/toilets: OSM maps drinking-water tap and toilets inside/at campground area. Treat as customer/private service rather than public trail water.
notes: WST lists 13 km, 5-6 h and hard; Naturkartan lists 13.5 km, 360 min and red; computed WST/Naturkartan GPX length is about 13.463 km.
WST attributes Stage 23 to Tanums kommun, while Naturkartan API links the same site to Dals-Ed.
Swedish WST includes the road 166/private-road/Norane walking warning; English text may not surface it clearly.
Vassbotten has a current Västtrafik stop page and GTFS/map stop near the endpoint, but line 952 currently has no timetable.
OSM relation is connected if way orientation is solved, but naive stored-order concatenation creates a false 1.686 km jump.
Current campground restaurant appears to be Jill's Diner, while OSM may still show Jack's Place.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Nornäs facility cluster
facilities.description: Official Nornäs endpoint/start facility cluster with wind shelter, fireplace/grill, toilet, information, rubbish/waste and swimming/lake context. Cluster WST place and OSM shelter/toilet/waste/firepit/info/map objects. No potable drinking-water claim.

facilities.name: Älgafallet / Elgåfossen
facilities.description: Bohuslän's highest waterfall, also called Elgåfossen on the Norwegian side, with about 46 m total fall. Officially highlighted near the end of Stage 23; bridge below the falls crosses into Norway and information describes border history. Cluster WST and OSM waterfall records. Waterfall flow varies seasonally; field reports say it is strongest after rain or in wetter seasons.

facilities.name: Älgafallet Swedish-side parking
facilities.description: Small Swedish-side parking/roadside access near the route above Älgafallet. Parking capacity/legal signage should be live-checked before user-facing directions.

facilities.name: Enningsdalen rasteplass
facilities.description: Norwegian-side access/rest area for Älgafallet with parking, toilet, picnic/rest area and information. Tourism source says parking accommodates buses and has accessible boardwalk/gravel path toward the falls. Keep separate from the waterfall POI. Norwegian-side facility; check cross-border access and current toilet status before relying on it.

facilities.name: Bullarebygdens Familjecamping
facilities.description: Commercial camping south of Vassbotten with tent/caravan pitches, cottages, service house, shop/reception, beach/swimming, canoeing and other customer facilities. Customer/commercial services, not free public trail facilities. Cluster campground, toilets, water, beach, shop/reception and restaurant area before import.

facilities.name: Bullarebygdens customer water/toilets
facilities.description: OSM maps drinking-water tap and toilets inside/at campground area. Treat as customer/private service rather than public trail water. Do not import as public drinking water. Customer access, opening and fee/guest status need verification.

facilities.name: Vassbotten / Bullarebygdens bathing place
facilities.description: Bathing/swimming place south of the endpoint, likely associated with lake/camping area. Not on the core route; import only if nearby/off-route services are modeled.
